name: With Every Heartbeat
source:
The average heart beats a hundred thousand times a day. That's how long it took Dakota Winchester to fall for you. A hundred thousand heartbeats...

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/With_Every_Heartbeat]Choices Wikia[/url]]
